env.name: IVN_LIBRARY_APP
env.about: Your app's id in the App library, in lower case with underscores: for the prefix ACME TEL, acme_tel. Each shop that installs your app connects with a key that names this id.

env.name: TEL_PREFIX
env.about: The prefix your app's names in the shop start with, in capitals: the --prefix you gave start.py (for example ACME TEL).

env.name: TEL_API
env.about: The telecom company's API address. Each retailer's own account at it is read from that retailer's settings record at every call.
